user.title: Choose a provider
user.description:
One provider with a key is enough to set up the integration. More can be added afterwards on the integration page via “Add provider” — each one gives the profiles a fallback. The providers marked “recommended” are enough to start with.

{cards}

data_description.api_key: Checked right away with a real request. If it succeeds, everything is saved — the integration then measures in the background what each model can do.

error.key_no_subscription: The key is valid, but no quota is enabled for this model. With Mistral, for example, a new key alone is not enough — the API subscription with the FREE plan is required as well, which is separate from Le Chat and Labs.
error.key_rate_limited: The provider reports a reached limit. This may be the key or simply the timing — trying again in a few minutes will tell.
error.key_unreachable: The provider is not responding or returns a server error. This is usually not caused by the key — trying again in a few minutes will tell.

abort.already_configured: Free AI Router is already set up. Additional providers can be added on the integration page via “Add provider”.

create_entry.default:
**Key checked:** {check}

Free AI Router is set up and ready to use. What each {name} model can do is now being measured in the background — this takes one to two minutes, and the result arrives as a notification. Until then, the values from the provider file apply.

Expected profile coverage:

{overview}

{empfehlung} Additional providers can be added on the integration page via “Add provider”.

### Next steps

- **Connect Assist:** [Open voice assistants](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/voice_assistants/) and select Free AI Router as the conversation agent — the preferred AI task entity is set on the same page.
- **Set up camera analysis:** [Import blueprint](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/blueprint_import/?blueprint_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FMarcusStockhaus%2Fha-free-ai-router%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fblueprints%2Fautomation%2Ffree_ai_router%2Fcamera_analysis.yaml)
- **Set up doorbell analysis:** [Import blueprint](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/blueprint_import/?blueprint_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FMarcusStockhaus%2Fha-free-ai-router%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fblueprints%2Fautomation%2Ffree_ai_router%2Fdoorbell.yaml)

kein_anbieter.title: No AI provider set up
kein_anbieter.description:
Free AI Router has no provider to send requests to. The entities exist, but every call fails.

Add one under Settings → Devices & services → Free AI Router → Add provider.

schluessel_abgelehnt.title: {anbieter} rejects the key

profil_ohne_abdeckung.title: Profile “{profil}” has no channel
profil_ohne_abdeckung.description:
No model meets the requirements of the profile “{profil}”. The corresponding entity exists, but every call fails.

Another provider usually helps. For image analysis the cause is almost always that no configured model accepts images — the integration measures this with your own key, and the measurement takes precedence over the provider file.

budget_aufgebraucht.title: {anbieter}: monthly budget used up
budget_aufgebraucht.description:
{anbieter} has used {ausgegeben} of {budget} US dollars this month. The free tier is closed until the first of next month.

Requests continue through the other providers — this only becomes noticeable when their quota runs short. Add another provider if you need the buffer, or wait for the new month.

The amount is calculated locally from the measured tokens and the price list in the provider file. The provider's own billing is authoritative.

neu_vermessen.name: Measure again
neu_vermessen.description: Measures all models of the configured providers again, including those that already work. In the background only new, previously disrupted and week-old unusable models are measured. Anything that is only temporarily disrupted during this measurement does not overwrite existing results.

anbieter.name: Providers
anbieter.description: Provider IDs such as google_ai_studio or groq. Leave empty for all configured providers.

nur_lebendigkeit.name: Liveness only
nur_lebendigkeit.description: One request per model instead of the costly checks for images, schemas and tools. Fast and economical, keeps the capabilities measured so far.
